parsed.note_claim: The interception of the Tagor was lawful under UNCLOS due to suspected statelessness, not an act of war.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Under Article 110 of UNCLOS, the reasonable suspicion of statelessness grants warships the Right of Visit.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the interception was lawful under UNCLOS due to statelessness, but cites Article 110 instead of the note's Article 165(1)(d) and does not specify the Madagascar flag.
